accountIntro: Buy, sell and manage business hardware. Create your free GuildMark account to get started.
emailHint: Use an address you can access. We’ll confirm it when you verify your business to sell.
passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters. You can paste from your password manager.
passwordMismatch: Passwords don’t match. Re-enter your confirmation password.
accountNotice: No paid subscription starts at signup. You can browse and buy immediately. Verify your business before publishing listings or making sales.
storyIntro: A new home for your business hardware. List retired equipment, find your next device and keep your fleet in view.
progress: Your account and optional business badge
stepAccountBody: Create your account and start using GuildMark.
stepBusinessBody: Confirm your email and business details before selling.
stepReviewBody: After approval, publish listings and earn your business badge.
storyNote: Browse, buy and prepare your inventory now. Business verification is required before selling.
businessIntro: Confirm your work email and registered business details. Our team must approve your business before you can publish listings or make sales.
registrationHelp: Use the number issued by your business registry, not a personal or tax identification number. Sole proprietors: contact us if you do not have one.
codeSent: Code sent. Check your inbox. It expires in 10 minutes.
pendingIntro: Our team is reviewing your business. You can still browse, buy and manage inventory. Publishing listings and making new sales will be available after approval.
needs_informationIntro: Our review team needs the information below. Update your details and resubmit. Verification must be approved before you can sell.
rejectedIntro: The reason is below. Selling remains unavailable. You can still browse, buy and manage inventory. Contact us if you believe something was missed.
approvedTitle: Your business is ready to sell.
approvedIntro: Our team has reviewed your business registration and authority to represent it. You can now publish listings and sell, with a Verified business badge.
requestFailed: We couldn’t complete that request. Try again.
loadFailed: We couldn’t load your application. Try refreshing.
verificationNotice: Approval is required before selling. The Verified business badge confirms a business review, not equipment quality or transaction outcomes.
badgeMeaning: Business registration and authority to represent the business reviewed by GuildMark. Not a guarantee of any listing or transaction.
badgePrompt: Ready to sell? Verify your business.
badgePromptBody: You can browse, buy and prepare inventory now. Business approval is required before publishing listings or making sales.
